checklist.title: MERCHANT RECRUITMENT & REGISTRATION CHECKLIST
checklist.subtitle: Checklist for screening, document collection, menu preparation, submission readiness and follow-up.
checklist.purposeNoticeBody: Use this form before submitting any merchant application. Tick YES only when you have verified the item or seen clear supporting evidence. Tick NO when the item is missing or fails the requirement. Tick N/A only when it genuinely does not apply.
checklist.section1Title: 1. Agent Self-Check Before Signing Up a Merchant
checklist.section1Subtitle: Complete the agent self-assessment checklist before proceeding with merchant registration.
checklist.agentNotesPlaceholder: Add any specific remarks, missing document notes, or follow-up plans...
checklist.section2Subtitle: Evaluate merchant readiness across 20 qualification criteria.
checklist.successMsg: ✅ Merchant Recruitment Checklist submitted and saved to Supabase successfully!

selfCheckItems.title: Decision maker identified
selfCheckItems.desc: Am I speaking with the owner, director, authorised manager or a person who can approve registration and provide documents?

selfCheckItems.title: Business need understood
selfCheckItems.desc: Do I know why the merchant wants delivery-platform registration: more sales, new area coverage, marketing exposure, slow dine-in traffic or expansion?

selfCheckItems.title: Platform fit confirmed
selfCheckItems.desc: Is the merchant suitable for Foodpanda, GrabFood, ShopeeFood or both based on location, products, operational capacity and available documents?

selfCheckItems.title: Clear value proposition prepared
selfCheckItems.desc: Can I explain the benefits without promising guaranteed sales, guaranteed approval, fixed commission or a fixed activation date?

selfCheckItems.title: Consent obtained
selfCheckItems.desc: Has the merchant agreed to share business and identity documents for registration purposes?

selfCheckItems.title: Data handling explained
selfCheckItems.desc: Have I told the merchant how documents will be submitted and avoided keeping unnecessary copies on personal devices?

selfCheckItems.title: No false or altered documents
selfCheckItems.desc: Have I made it clear that edited, borrowed, expired or mismatched documents may cause rejection or account action?

selfCheckItems.title: No duplicate submission risk
selfCheckItems.desc: Have I checked whether the merchant, outlet or business entity already has an application or active account?

selfCheckItems.title: Realistic timeline set
selfCheckItems.desc: Have I explained that verification may take several working days and missing information will delay approval?

selfCheckItems.title: Follow-up plan agreed
selfCheckItems.desc: Did I set the next action, owner and date for each missing item?

selfCheckItems.title: Merchant can operate delivery orders
selfCheckItems.desc: Can the outlet prepare, pack, accept and hand over delivery orders consistently during operating hours?

selfCheckItems.title: Professional record created
selfCheckItems.desc: Have I recorded the lead source, remark, platform chosen and document status?

qualificationItems.title: Legal owner details available
qualificationItems.desc: Full name, IC/passport number, nationality, role in the business and authority to sign.

qualificationItems.title: Business registration status known
qualificationItems.desc: SSM-registered entity, sole proprietor, partnership, company or home-based/individual seller.

qualificationItems.title: Outlet type confirmed
qualificationItems.desc: Restaurant, cafe, kiosk, stall, food truck, cloud kitchen or home-based kitchen and mart.

qualificationItems.title: Exact operating address verified
qualificationItems.desc: Complete address, postcode, landmark and map pin/GPS location are accurate.

qualificationItems.title: Service-area availability checked
qualificationItems.desc: The outlet is within the current platform coverage area. Coverage is subject to platform confirmation.

qualificationItems.title: Food category identified
qualificationItems.desc: Cuisine type, best-selling items, average price, preparation time and expected daily order capacity.

qualificationItems.title: Products are suitable for delivery
qualificationItems.desc: Items can be packed safely and remain acceptable after delivery time.

qualificationItems.title: Food is legally permitted
qualificationItems.desc: No illegal, prohibited, unsafe or falsely claimed products; special licences are available where required.

qualificationItems.title: Halal classification confirmed
qualificationItems.desc: Certified Halal, non-Halal or not certified Halal is accurately declared; supporting certificate is available when claimed.

qualificationItems.title: Alcohol status confirmed
qualificationItems.desc: No alcohol sold, or a valid alcohol licence is available and platform approval will be requested.

qualificationItems.title: Local authority licence status known
qualificationItems.desc: Restaurant/business licence and other permits are valid where required.

qualificationItems.title: Banking arrangement ready
qualificationItems.desc: Active Malaysian bank account details are available for settlement and the account holder can be verified.

qualificationItems.title: Menu is ready
qualificationItems.desc: Item names, descriptions, prices, variants, add-ons and availability can be uploaded accurately.

qualificationItems.title: Original food photos available
qualificationItems.desc: Actual photos match the dishes; no stolen images, misleading graphics or prohibited content.

qualificationItems.title: Device and internet ready
qualificationItems.desc: A compatible smartphone/tablet and stable internet connection are available at the outlet.

qualificationItems.title: Order operator assigned
qualificationItems.desc: A trained staff member will monitor the merchant app, accept orders and update sold-out items.

qualificationItems.title: Packaging ready
qualificationItems.desc: Leak-resistant, tamper-aware and appropriate packaging is available; cutlery/condiments policy is defined.

qualificationItems.title: Operating hours confirmed
qualificationItems.desc: Delivery hours, preparation time, closing days and peak-hour capacity are realistic.

qualificationItems.title: Multiple-outlet plan clarified
qualificationItems.desc: Each outlet has accurate documents, address, menu and responsible staff. ShopeeFood generally requires the first store to be approved before additional stores are requested in-app.

qualificationItems.title: Owner understands commercial terms
qualificationItems.desc: Merchant will review the official agreement, commission/service fee, promotions, settlement, refunds and obligations before signing.
